name: pgvector (Postgres + pgvector)
note: README shows pgvector/pgvector:pg18-trixie (pg18 = bookworm alias); runs like the official postgres image, which requires POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

name: Qdrant
note: README: docker run -p 6333:6333 qdrant/qdrant. gRPC is 6334.

name: Weaviate
note: gRPC 50051. README example adds a text2vec-model2vec inference container (optional vectorizer module).

name: Milvus (standalone)
note: Official standalone_embed.sh runs embedded etcd + local storage (no MinIO); command 'milvus run standalone'; health on 9091. The docker-compose variant adds etcd + MinIO.

name: Chroma
note: docker run -v ./chroma-data:/data -p 8000:8000 chromadb/chroma

name: Neo4j
note: Bolt 7687, Browser/HTTP 7474. NEO4J_AUTH=<user>/<password> is optional (set in the Graphiti compose example).

name: LiteLLM proxy
note: Mount config at /app/config.yaml and pass --config. Postgres optional (needed for virtual keys, spend tracking, budgets). README recommends -stable tags (also on ghcr.io/berriai/litellm).

name: Langfuse
note: Official compose sets many env vars with CHANGEME defaults (NEXTAUTH_SECRET, SALT, ENCRYPTION_KEY, DB/ClickHouse/Redis/S3 URLs); use the compose file rather than a single container.

name: Arize Phoenix
note: 6006 = UI + OTLP HTTP; 4317 = OTLP gRPC. Postgres optional via PHOENIX_SQL_DATABASE_URL (SQLite default). Pin a version in production.

name: vLLM (OpenAI-compatible server)
note: Needs NVIDIA GPU (--runtime nvidia --gpus all, --ipc=host); pass --model <hf id>. HF_TOKEN needed for gated models.

name: Text Generation Inference
note: Container listens on 80 (README maps 8080:80); GPU; --model-id <model>. HF_TOKEN only for gated/private models.

name: Ollama
note: Not in catalog. CPU: docker run -d -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 ollama/ollama; GPU needs NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

name: Redis Stack
note: Redis Stack itself is not in catalog (closest: redis-agent-memory-server--gh-redis-agent-memory-server). REDIS_ARGS="--requirepass <pw>" recommended, not required; redis/redis-stack-server is the server-only image.

name: Temporal
note: temporalio/docker-compose is archived; samples-server/compose is the current official compose (UI on 8080). For local dev the docs also offer the CLI dev server (temporal server start-dev), no container.

name: Restate
note: 8080 ingress, 9070 admin API/UI, 9071 node-to-node.

name: Mem0 (OSS server)
note: No published server image: docker-compose builds from server/dev.Dockerfile (API 8888->8000, dashboard 3000). README: 'at minimum set POSTGRES_PASSWORD and OPENAI_API_KEY'.

name: Graphiti server (Zep)
note: Reference implementation only: README says no auth and not for production. Zep Community Edition is not offered; this is Graphiti's FastAPI server.

name: Letta server
note: Docs: 'The Docker image is no longer an actively maintained or supported Letta product surface.' Current path is letta-code (npm) 'letta server'. OPENAI_API_KEY shown as example, not strictly required.

name: Browserless
note: WebSocket at ws://localhost:3000; ghcr.io/browserless/firefox or /multi for other engines. TOKEN optional.

name: Steel browser
note: API + UI on 3000 (/ui); 9223 console debugger.

name: E2B self-host (E2B Embed)
note: Self-host supported (Apache-2.0) but not a single image: download compose.yaml + .env from e2b-dev/runtime/embed/compose and run 'docker compose up -d --wait' on a Linux host (Firecracker microVMs); also Terraform for GCP/AWS/Azure or Kubernetes. Image names come from the shipped .env; ports listed in docs/REFERENCE.md.
